risks: Severe competition in sales by small players in the industry functioning at nearby locations due to their less overheads and less taxes
Business of wedding and greeting cards industry continuously affected due to electronic modes of communications for all sorts of functions and celebrations
Technological developments in e-based communications reducing demand for paper-based cards
Changing mindset of younger generation towards digital invitations
Difficulty in arranging funds for design updation leading to increased cost of funds
Difficulty in finding skilled employees
Competition from small size operators in and around the company's location

outlook.statement: Because of the technological developments in the e-based communications of various invitations it is doubtful whether the Wedding Cards/Greeting Cards industry will have a turnaround in the near future.
Your company is expected to improve its business by providing its services through advanced techniques/consultations which may provide new opportunities to improve its business.
